children: Nutex Health said data from a previously disclosed cyber security event was published online and is being analyzed; no material operational impact identified to date.
Unauthorized actor published data allegedly obtained in the earlier cyber incident; company and forensics team are downloading and analyzing it.
Due to data volume, review of contents, scope and authenticity is expected to take several weeks.
No material impact on business operations or financial reporting systems identified to date.
Company’s materiality assessment remains unchanged; further updates and required notifications will be made as findings develop.
Several putative class actions were filed; company cannot predict litigation outcome or potential impacts at this stage.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Nutex Health says stolen data published online; review ongoing, no material operational impact
